hero.lede: Each language lives in its own small file. Pick one above: only that file is downloaded, only once, and every line changes in the same moment.

log.title: Downloaded locale files
log.note: Read from the browser’s Resource Timing API. Return to a language you have already used and no new row appears.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.only_en: This sentence exists only in the English file.
fallback.native: Pick another language: this sentence has no translation there, so English will stand in.
fallback.falls_back: This sentence is not translated into {language}, so the English version is shown.

missing.title: Missing key
missing.note: This key is in no file, so the key itself is shown and reported to onMissing, the console and the dev overlay.
